final: WITH acc AS (SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_amount, txn_count, CAST(total_amount AS REAL) / SUM(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share FROM acc ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
